# Narasimha Skill Sphere

> Hands-on, practical learning-by-doing in STEM, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL), Coding, and 3D Printing for schools, educators, and K-12 students.

Narasimha Skill Sphere Private Limited (NSS) is a DPIIT (Startup India) recognized, Startup Bihar supported, and MSME registered educational technology enterprise headquartered in Bihar, India. NSS bridges classroom learning with real-world technological capability by establishing cutting-edge STEM/ATL labs in partner schools and running direct offline innovation learning centers.

## Core Offerings & Pages

- [Home & School Partnerships](https://www.narasimhaskillsphere.com/): Comprehensive overview of our mission, pedagogy, school lab partnerships, curriculum, and national recognitions.
- [Patna Innovation Center](https://www.narasimhaskillsphere.com/centers): Flagship offline center at Kankarbagh, Patna offering structured weekend and evening tracks in Robotics, Coding, Drones, and IoT for Grades 1–12.
- [Student Projects & Event Gallery](https://www.narasimhaskillsphere.com/gallery): Filterable visual showcase of student inventions, drone tests, robotic combat leagues, championship awards, and ATL sessions.
- [Curriculum & Programs](https://www.narasimhaskillsphere.com/#specialized-courses): Detailed tracks including Block Coding, Scratch, Python & Applied AI, Arduino C++, IoT & Smart Home, 3D Design, 3D Printing, Drone Tech, and Mechanical Robotics.

## Institutional Recognitions & Credentials

- **Startup India (DPIIT)**: Recognized under Govt. of India's flagship startup initiative.
- **Startup Bihar**: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar supported startup.
- **NITI Aayog / AIM Ecosystem**: Facilitator and implementer of Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL) and maker pedagogy aligned with NEP 2020.
- **Skill India**: Aligned with modern national vocational and digital literacy initiatives.
- **MSME Registered**: Enterprise registered under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India.
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Certified quality management for education and technical training delivery.

## Learning Methodology & Age Tiers

Our proprietary pedagogy is based on the **"Learning-By-Doing"** philosophy and the **E3 Framework** (Explore, Experiment, Excel):
1. **Starter Track (Grades 1–4, Ages 6–9)**: Visual block coding, LEGO-compatible motorized mechanics, basic electronics, simple sensors, and spatial reasoning.
2. **Learner Track (Grades 5–8, Ages 10–13)**: Arduino microcontroller programming, C/C++ basics, Python fundamentals, IoT sensor interfacing, mechanical gear systems, and 3D CAD modeling.
3. **Performer Track (Grades 9–12 & College, Ages 14+)**: Applied AI & Machine Learning, computer vision, autonomous drone assembly & PID tuning, industrial IoT, PCB design, 3D rapid prototyping, and competitive robotics.
